source: Observed with a temporary terminal tab and the live Dock, 2026-10-11
statement: In cmux 0.65.0, `cmux surface resume show --json --surface <ref>` for a terminal without a binding exits 0 with "resume_binding": null; agent-hook bindings (Claude Code, Codex) carry a `command` that starts with `cd -- '<working directory>'`. `cmux new-surface` prints `OK surface:<n> pane:<n> workspace:<n>`.
